{{Quote|The Imperial dreadnaught ''Red Reaper'' and its master, Darth Ikoral, have been located in the Bormea Sector.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bormea sector''' was located in the [[Ringali Shell]], at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and [[Nopces Prime]]. The [[Ringali Nebula/Legends|Ringali Nebula]] also curved around this sector.

==History==
[[Senator/Legends|Senators]] were [[Arcel Mosbree]] of Brentaal (Galactic Republic), [[Zafiel Snopps]] of Corulag (New Republic), and [[Morvis (senator)|Morvis]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of Chandrila (Galactic Republic). During Imperial rule, Mon Mothma was briefly replaced by Senator [[Canna Omonda]] and the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jamson Caglio]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the sector had been unimportant for several decades. It was defended by two [[Superiority fleet]]s with a [[Deepdock fleet|Deepdock]] and [[Support fleet]] as auxiliary forces. The Empire classified the sector as "Passive" before the depredations of the ''[[Far Orbit]]''.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Bormea sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
